contract.traceability: Reference `ref` (TestRail case id, e.g. C4099911) in each automated test so a result maps back to its case.

cases.title: Barcode — offline validations stored until reconnect

gherkin.given:
**GIVEN** the POS is offline with no connection to CloudFare/Corethree
**AND** single-use barcodes at or below the offline Ceiling Limit are available to validate
**AND** example: two Rail single-use barcodes validated while offline, then the POS reconnects

steps.then: **THEN** the offline validations are stored in a list on the device

steps.then: **THEN** the transaction appears in MERIT

cases.title: Barcode — a single-use barcode is validated online and shows a green tick

gherkin.given:
**GIVEN** a POS is signed on in rail mode with a live connection to Corethree
**AND** single-use rail barcode types B, U, E, S, D and H are accepted on a POS (Translink scheme id 5720)
**AND** example: a type B (no-date) single-use barcode for product 640 Cross Border Standard Adult Single, presented within its validity window

**AND** a green tick is shown
**AND** a success tone is played

steps.then: **THEN** the ticket type Display Description is shown on the result screen

cases.title: Barcode — a multiple-use barcode is rejected as not accepted on the POS

cases.title: Barcode — offline single-use validation is allowed only at or below the Ceiling Limit

**GIVEN** a POS is signed on but offline from Corethree

cases.title: Barcode — an offline single-use redemption syncs back to Corethree on reconnect

**GIVEN** a POS validated a single-use barcode offline while disconnected from Corethree

cases.title: Barcode — a successful single-use validation is audited as an event, not a MERIT transaction

gherkin.given:
**GIVEN** a POS validated a single-use barcode successfully

cases.title: Card Payment — declined, cancelled or error

gherkin.given:
**GIVEN** the POS is signed on as an Operator in NIR or Ulsterbus mode with a PCD attached

**THEN** a declined message is shown
**AND** a declined receipt is printed

steps.when: **WHEN** the customer cancels on the PIN pad before entering the PIN
steps.then:
**THEN** the transaction is cancelled
**AND** no cancelled-payment receipt is printed

steps.when: **WHEN** the PIN is entered incorrectly too many times, or the signature does not match
steps.then:
**THEN** the matching error message (driven by the M020/PCD) is shown
**AND** choosing Print Receipt or Back to Main returns to the FLU screen (a 3-second timeout or any key instead returns to the payment screen)

steps.when: **WHEN** the transaction amount is too large for the card (test transactions only)
steps.then:
**THEN** the Amount Too Large error is shown
**AND** choosing Print Receipt or Back to Main returns to the FLU screen (a 3-second timeout or any key instead returns to the payment screen)

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

gherkin.expected: Each card error path shows its correct message and recovery — declined (with receipt), cancelled-before-PIN (no receipt); too-many-PIN-attempts and signature-mismatch are live decline reasons, amount-too-large is a test-transactions-only condition; all three return to FLU via the operator's receipt choice, or to the payment screen via timeout/any-key.

gherkin.given:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on to the POS in Ulsterbus mode
**AND** an Ulsterbus Multi-Journey smartcard is presented
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** example: Ulsterbus Multi-Journey, select the card's reference number, add 10 journeys, paid by Cash

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator selects the card reference and journeys and takes payment
steps.then:
**THEN** the journeys are added to the card
**AND** the added journeys are shown
**AND** the card cannot exceed its maximum permitted journeys

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

steps.when: **WHEN** the data is reviewed in MERIT
steps.then: **THEN** the transaction appears in MERIT

steps.when: **WHEN** the smartcard record is reviewed in SmartTrack
steps.then: **THEN** the updated smartcard record appears in SmartTrack

gherkin.expected: An Ulsterbus Multi-Journey top-up adds and shows journeys via the card-reference-then-journeys flow and enforces the maximum (regression: TIBU-26861, TIBU-21133).
